root_cause: LinkedIn personal and company reused one connection resolver; auth-config scopes were treated too strongly while exact connected-token organization capability could differ.
prevention: Resolve personal and company LinkedIn connections independently.
Company connection selection requires live GET_MY_INFO plus GET_COMPANY_INFO administrator proof for the configured organization.
Persist provider IDs immediately and never duplicate when readback is uncertain.
Daily unresolved approved obligations re-enter the same claim via watchdog/self-healing.
Instagram missing final media is autonomously completed inside the same Mira claim.
Buffer and Make are not social publication fallbacks.
